newsitem.title: USA: Motorola unit to open education center.
newsitem.headline: Motorola unit to open education center.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Monday its Cellular Infrastructure Group will open a Technical Education and Documentation Center in Mundelien, Illinois, next spring.

The facility will provide product technical education training to customers from around the world, the company said. Classes will be taught in 12 languages, including Russian, Japanese, Mandarin, Portuguese and Spanish.
The center will employ more than 125 people, providing classes and services to more than 100 customers weekly.
Motorola is a leading semiconductor and communications products manufacturing company.
The company's stock was up 1-1/4 at 58-7/8.
